title: Zesty Silky Egyptian Oats Pilaf
description: A briny, silky, and indulgent Egyptian dish featuring porridge oats, perfect for a pescatarian-friendly meal. This recipe combines the warmth of oats with the zest of lemon and the richness of seafood.
instructions: Rinse the oats in a fine mesh sieve and drain well.
Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes, until pink and cooked through.
Add the oats, water, lemon juice, salt, black pepper, and paprika to the saucepan.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes, until the oats are silky and the liquid is absorbed.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley or dill, if desired.
